answer_1.quote: In Section 2, we show that these MT intuitions can be quantified and explained via cross-entropy power law scaling; using a handful of experiments on small subsets of MT datasets, we precisely predict the performance of large systems trained on orders of magnitude more data.
datasets: WMT 2017 and OpenSubtitles2018 for de-en, ru-en, zh-en
Tagalog-English (tl-en) and Swahili-English (sw-en) from Zavorin et al., 2020

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we use newstest2016 concatenated with the last 2500 lines of OpenSubtitles2018... predict the achieved BLEU score, which is more interpretable to humans as a measure of adequacy, fidelity, and fluency.
